levels.name: Ice Unleashed
levels.description: The last attack of Chongyun's Normal Attack combo releases 3 ice blades. Each blade deals 50% of Chongyun's ATK as Cryo DMG to all opponents in its path.

levels.name: Atmospheric Revolution
levels.description: Elemental Skills and Elemental Bursts cast within the Frost Field created by Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost have their CD time decreased by 15%.

levels.name: Cloudburst
levels.description: Increases the Level of Spirit Blade: Cloud-Parting Star by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Frozen Skies
levels.description: Chongyun regenerates 1 Energy every time he hits an opponent affected by Cryo. This effect can only occur once every 2s.

levels.name: The True Path
levels.description: Increases the Level of Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Rally of Four Blades
levels.description: Spirit Blade: Cloud-Parting Star deals 15% more DMG to opponents with a lower percentage of their Max HP remaining than Chongyun. This skill will also summon 1 additional spirit blade.
